title: Priority-Aware Scheduler for Serverless Functions Provision and Load Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2610.35073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Serverless computing has emerged as a pivotal cloud deployment paradigm due to its efficient utilization of on-demand resources. However, the persistent cold start problem continues to hinder system performance. Current strategies often employ oversimplified preloading/unloading mechanisms that inadequately exploit invocation patterns, failing to optimize the critical trade-off between startup latency and resource efficiency. Furthermore, existing approaches disregard practical constraints of memory-limited multi-worker environments, exacerbating function eviction and load imbalance issues. To address these limitations, we present SPES-Ext, a rule-based priority-aware scheduler designed for memory-constrained distributed worker nodes. translated_title: 面向无服务器函数供应与负载均衡的优先级感知调度器
translated_abstract: 无服务器计算因其高效利用按需资源而成为关键的云部署范式。然而，持续存在的冷启动问题仍然阻碍着系统性能。当前策略通常采用过于简化的预加载/卸载机制，未能充分利用调用模式，无法优化启动延迟与资源效率之间的关键权衡。此外，现有方法忽略了内存受限的多工作节点环境的实际约束，加剧了函数驱逐和负载不均衡问题。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了SPES-Ext，一个面向内存受限分布式工作节点的基于规则的优先级感知调度器。我们的方法源于两个关键观察：（1）无服务器系统表现出集中的调用模式，使行为具有可预测性；（2）这些模式允许对函数进行分类
tldr: 本文提出SPES-Ext，一种面向内存受限分布式工作节点的基于规则的优先级感知调度器，通过利用无服务器系统集中的调用模式进行行为预测和函数分类，优化冷启动、函数驱逐和负载不均衡问题，在启动延迟与资源效率之间实现权衡。
en_tdlr: We propose SPES-Ext, a rule-based priority-aware scheduler for memory-constrained distributed worker nodes, which exploits concentrated invocation patterns for behavior prediction and function categorization to mitigate cold starts, function eviction, and load imbalance while optimizing the trade-off between startup latency and resource efficiency.
